name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more correspondents by ID. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; submission does not confirm recipient delivery.

name: fork_session
description: Fork an activity from your retained history and the supplied task, returning its stable session_id. The inherited history includes the complete calling model/tool round. Your activation continues. Its new assistant text accompanies your later ordinary inputs without activating you; its session ending requests an input even without new text.

name: send_session_message
description: Durably queue an observation for an existing session. A dormant recipient becomes ready; an active recipient receives it between complete model/tool rounds.

session_id.description: The current roster lists existing sessions.

name: wakeup
description: Schedule one observation for the core and return its callback_id. The arrangement survives restart. Past times are due immediately; inference can occur later.

at_unix_ms.description: Current runtime time is supplied in state.

text.description: What to reconsider when this observation arrives.
